stories.title: Russian Warship Fires Flares at Danish Helicopter in Baltic Sea Incident
stories.summary: A Russian frigate reportedly fired flares at a Danish military helicopter during an encounter in the Baltic Sea, prompting Denmark to summon Russia's ambassador. Danish Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen condemned the act as 'reckless,' while the Kremlin has not yet commented on the incident. This event is seen as part of a broader pattern of aggressive Russian behavior in the region.

stories.title: Supreme Court Rejects Trump's Mail Voting Restrictions, Sparks His Criticism
stories.summary: The U.S. Supreme Court has rejected efforts by Donald Trump to impose new restrictions on mail-in voting ahead of the midterm elections. This ruling allows states to continue using existing mail voting procedures. Following the decision, Trump criticized the court and specifically called out Justices Samuel Alito and Clarence Thomas for their dissenting opinions.

However, Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelensky stated that Ukraine is prepared to de-escalate only if Russia halts its strikes. Despite Trump's claims, reports indicate that both sides have continued their energy attacks, with Ukraine warning of intensified Russian strikes on its rail network.
